regressionEvidence.result: Forced dropped click #13; 13 landings in 8 seconds, safe finish after retry fix. Harness, not installed-app R route.
Release at 5.004s during runup; five landings, safe stop.
Latest source harness mixed modes, 21 landings in 14 seconds, safe finish.

failedDevelopmentTrials.result: Fell on first flat cycle after rising; fixed by landing and rebuilding runway at transition.
Forced missed click exposed failed lower-bridge recovery. That recovery was removed; unconsumed-click retry tested instead.

camera.observations: Outbound/return are visible across several consecutive frames. Face perspective continues changing during the placement arc, with a forward-facing section between turns. Rain and nighttime reduce visibility. No F3, so screenshots alone cannot establish exact per-frame angular velocity or absence of every stutter.

limits: Final-binary acceptance is one 40-second cardinal mixed-mode trial, not a universal reliability guarantee.
Other cardinal/pitch standalone trials used preceding candidate; results are not relabelled as final-binary trials.
First four means four new horizontal block positions, not exactly four blocks of player-center displacement.
No diagonal or multiplayer-server acceptance test in this release.
Two-block rising adjustments remain isolated in recorded passing trials.
